label: Improved method: 2025 data with the corrections and the improved method
description: The 2025 data of 2025-fuel with the corrections (biodiesel-yield (biodiesel yield from oilseeds: oil content counted once); beef-carcase-yield (beef carcase-to-retail yield restored (0.705))) and the improved method (line 2): reserve-pro-rata (reserve and infrastructure shortfall shared across cropping, pasture and non-agricultural land); recycling-stage (recycling split by stage, origin, dry matter, the law in force and uptake by stage). Compare with 2025-fixed for the effect of the improvements alone.
